description.value: Old-growth rainforest backs onto a 1.2 km sandy Pacific beach at this well-serviced Huu-ay-aht campground near Bamfield and the West Coast Trail trailhead; the access road is chip-sealed but an active logging road shared with trucks.

address.value: 90 Emchiss Way, Bamfield, BC V0R 1B0, Canada

raw_osm.description: RV and tent sites in forest, access to fine sand Pachena Beach. Wifi near main building.
raw_osm.name: Pachena Bay Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pachena Bay Campground is an active campground operated by Huu-ay-aht First Nations, located 5 km from Bamfield on Vancouver Island's west coast near the West Coast Trail trailhead. The FAQ page explicitly confirms potable water ('access to potable water throughout the Campground at marked blue water taps'), coin-operated hot showers in a wash house, and online booking/reservations. The front page mentions the Malsit Public House in nearby Bamfield (~3 km away) for food. Phone 1-250-728-1287 appears on the website but OSM has no phone field to cross-check. No specific hiker/biker sites, cyclist discounts, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website shows 1-250-728-1287
OSM record has no address; website does not provide a street address either
Cell service is very limited at the campground, which may affect cyclists needing connectivity
Road to Bamfield is a chip-sealed active logging road — may be challenging for loaded touring bikes
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-maintained campground with tent sites, showers, and potable water at a scenic west-coast location reachable by road from Port Alberni — a natural stop for touring cyclists heading to or from Bamfield and the West Coast Trail.

wow_evidence: campground operated by Huu-ay-aht First Nations ... West Coast Trail trailhead ... 1.2 km sandy Pacific beach
